gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests {@link JulianDate#until(java.time.temporal.Temporal, TemporalUnit)}.

Each case measures the amount of time between a {@code start} and an {@code end}
ADDED i2: Cases of: startDate, endDate, unit, expectedAmount. Grouped by unit; within each unit the dates are given as (year, month, day).
ADDED i3: DAYS: counted exactly, may be negative when the end is before the start.
ADDED i4: WEEKS: one whole week is reached only at start + 7 days.
ADDED i5: MONTHS: one whole month is reached only when the day-of-month is met again.
ADDED i6: YEARS: one whole year is reached only when the month/day is met again.
ADDED i7: DECADES: one whole decade is 10 years.
ADDED i8: CENTURIES: one whole century is 100 years.
ADDED i9: MILLENNIA: one whole millennium is 1000 years.
ADDED i10: ERAS: crossing from the BC era (proleptic year <= 0) to the AD era is one era.
